notes.decision: ⲟⲩⲱⲗⲡ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = 'reveal forth, uncover.' With ⲍⲁ ('concerning, regarding'), the construction is 'he revealed to me concerning X.' This anaphoric formula opens each item in Mani's catalogue of mysteries shown by the Paraclete.
Translated as 'the Deep' and 'the Height' — the cosmic vertical axis (νοῦν / ⲡⲭⲥⲉ = ⲡϫⲓⲥⲉ). These are paired cosmological extremes flanking Light/Darkness in the Manichaean catalogue.

ⲡⲟⲩⲧⲱⲧ from ⲧⲱⲧ ('agree, join') = 'their joining/agreement.' ⲥⲉⲍⲟ likely from ⲥⲱϩⲉ ('to draw, drag') — 'they were drawn up.' The image is of mixed elements being drawn upward into this cosmos through the joining of Light and Darkness.
Standard idiom 'open my eyes' = reveal/enlighten (per accumulated vocabulary). Preserves the literal eye-rousing image even where 'reveal' would smooth.
ⲭⲏⲩ = ϫⲏⲩ 'ships' — the cosmic vessels (sun and moon) that bear refined light upward. Standard Manichaean cosmological term.

ⲥⲱⲧϥ = 'refine, filter' (cf. ⲥⲁⲧϩ in accumulated vocabulary). The ships function to filter/refine the Light out of the mixture — this is the central cosmic function of the luminaries in Manichaean physics.
ⲍⲱⲱϥ ('itself') intensifies — 'the Erring itself,' i.e. the cosmic principle of Error in person, not merely an act of erring.
Greek loanword πλάσσειν 'to mold/form (clay).' Used here of Adam's creation; preserved as 'molding' to keep the demiurgic clay-imagery distinct from ⲙⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛⲕ and ⲙⲟⲣⲫⲏ.

Double brackets in transcription mark scribal dittography: the scribe began writing this clause, recognized it as a duplicate of lines 18–19, and cancelled it. Treated here as a restoration entry noting the cancellation; the running translation continues directly from ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲛⲧⲟⲗⲁⲩⲉ to the catechumens-mystery on line 17.
ⲧⲕⲟⲗⲁⲥⲓⲥ = Greek κόλασις 'punishment/chastisement.' ⲁⲏⲟ̄ ⲛⲉⲩ = 'set/laid upon them' (qualitative of ⲁϩⲉ 'to stand, set'). Renders the punishment as imposed.
Cognate-figura etymologica: 'reflection reflects upon it.' Preserves the verbal-noun pairing in English. ⲡⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ is the fifth faculty (per mandatory terminology).
'I beheld the All through him.' ⲡⲧⲏⲣϥ ('the All') is the Manichaean designation for the totality of cosmic reality; the Paraclete is the medium through whom Mani sees it whole.
'In the last years of Ardashir.' Marks the historical anchor: Mani's first public mission in the closing years of Ardashir I (d. 242 CE).
ⲭⲓⲟⲣⲉ = ϫⲓⲟⲟⲣ 'cross over (water), traverse.' Used twice on this page (here for the voyage to India, again on line 29 for the return). 'Crossed over' preserves the maritime sense.

ⲇⲉⲭⲉ = Greek δέχομαι 'receive, welcome.' ⲁϩⲍⲗⲗⲟ uncertain — possibly an auxiliary or a verbal idiom (perhaps 'he came to receive me') but the core meaning 'received me with great honor' is secure from ⲇⲉⲭⲉ ⲙⲙⲁⲓ̈ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲟ.

⳨ resolved as ⲣ̄: ⲁϥⲣ̄ ⲙⲁ ⲛⲏⲓ̈ = 'he made room/place for me' = idiom 'he gave me leave.' ⲧⲁⲙⲁⲍⲉ = ⲧⲁⲙⲁϩⲉ 'walking/traveling' (from ⲙⲟⲟϣⲉ). Idiom for granting freedom of travel within Shapur's domains.
Latin comitatus 'imperial retinue/court' transliterated through Greek κομιτᾶτον. Refers to Shapur's mobile royal court; Mani is described as accompanying it for many years.

proposed_terms.rationale: Greek loanword ὁ νοῦν? No — Coptic ⲛⲟⲩⲛ from Egyptian Nun, the primordial waters / abyss. Paired here antithetically with ⲡⲭⲥⲉ ('the Height'). 'The Deep' preserves both the cosmological-vertical pairing and the abyssal connotation.
Lycopolitan ⲭⲥⲉ = Sahidic ϫⲓⲥⲉ 'height, elevation.' Functions as the upper cosmological pole paired with ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ. Translating as 'the Height' preserves the spatial axis.
Lycopolitan ⲭⲏⲩ = ϫⲏⲩ 'ships, vessels.' In Manichaean cosmology these are the cosmic light-vessels (sun and moon) that ferry refined light upward. Standard technical term.
ⲡⲧⲏⲣϥ literally 'the whole/all of it' = the totality of being. Manichaean cosmological term for the entire cosmic system. Preserve as 'the All' (capitalized) to flag its technical sense.
Compound: ⲣⲉϥ ('one who does') + ⲣ̄-ⲛⲁⲃⲉ ('does sin') = 'sinner.' Standard form, paralleling ⲣⲉϥ†ⲥⲃⲱ ('teacher').

Lycopolitan reflex of ⲛⲍⲉⲛⲧⲟⲩ / ⲛϩⲉⲛⲧⲟⲩ 'Indians' (from Old Persian Hind-, via Aramaic). Geographical term for the inhabitants of the Indus region; matches the well-attested account of Mani's first missionary voyage to the Indus valley under Ardashir.
ⲡⲉⲣⲥⲏⲥ = the people, ⲡⲉⲣⲥⲓⲥ = the country. Standard ethnonym/toponym pair for the Iranian Sasanian heartland (Pārs/Fārs).

Latin comitatus via Greek κομιτᾶτον — the mobile imperial court of the Sasanian king. Mani is reported to have accompanied Shapur's traveling court for many years; the technical Roman/Sasanian administrative sense should be preserved.
